forum.title: When the XSPI2 frequency of STM32H7R7L8H6H exceeds 133MHz, the external NOR flash gets stuck due to timeout
forum.best_answer_content: The issue has been resolved. Simply open HSLV in STM32CubeProgrammer and enable the high-speed mode![1.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/21be0918-43fd-3f0c-3163-ae62313fc15b.png "1.png")
forum.content_text:
STM32H7R7L8H6H XSPI2 is mounted with MX25UM25645GXDI00, and the frequency setting exceeds 133Mhz. The Boot program fails to run and gets stuck in the "XSPI\_WaitFlagStateUntilTimeout" function.

Please help me!![XSPI2 Configuration](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/eb36f5ad-bd1c-362f-c821-d1a280d7471d.png "1.png")XSPI2 Configuration![Clock Tree Configuration](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/909a34e0-a44d-67a8-5006-1793046adfb1.png "2.png")Clock Tree Configuration![EXTMEM_MANAGER Config 1](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c60c1101-5ebf-167b-91c8-a73f4d93ee00.png "3.png")EXTMEM\_MANAGER Config 1![EXTMEM_MANAGER Config 2](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ffb53ae2-6b5a-2409-e910-e7f6f36b9fb1.png "4.png")EXTMEM\_MANAGER Config 2![Stuck here](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/599c8a8d-9a8a-f5a7-9a2d-eddabb745ec7.png "5.png")Stuck here
